text:
jess_cs: Heads up — Sable Insurance submitted an intake: custom NER for claims to extract names, policy_numbers, and ICD codes. They stressed PHI residency, want safety signoff before renewal in ~5w. Can ENG + SAFETY + SRE advise? :wave:

Tom_eng: Do they have span-labeled data? format? If it's JSONL spans we can run quick evals. My baseline suggestion: 7B-quant on Dedicated first; upgrade to 13B only if recall/safety fails.

jess_cs: They have ~6k JSONL span labels. Typical seq ~220 tokens, peak 2 qps. They require customer-managed keys / HSM option. Contacts: marta@sable.com (AM), rui@sable.com (ML).

Maya_safety: We'll need a 100-sample unredacted/redacted pair for leakage tests. Proposed gates: entity F1 >= 0.9 for critical PHI, phi_leak_rate < 0.5%. Also confirm retention policy and whether outputs can be logged.

Nora_enable: I'll own onboarding — 45m workshop + checklist + demo notebook. Recommend AM + ML + security attend. I'll send calendar options.

Li_sre: Sizing Qs: p95 latency SLO? For 2 qps and <512 tokens, Dedicated 7B-quant with 1 A100 should meet p95 <500ms with small batching. Private + HSM will require infra inventory from their ops.

Tom_eng: Ask them to upload a 200-sample mixed file to s3://sable-onboard/secure/ner_200_sample.jsonl and grant our VPC read. I'll run AB evals (7b-q vs 13b-fp16) and produce per-label F1 + leak report. Example eval line:

```
redwood eval run --model redwood/7b-q --dataset s3://sable-onboard/secure/ner_200_sample.jsonl \
  --metrics entity_f1,phi_leak_rate --output s3://cs-results/sable/7b_eval
```

Maya_safety: Also plan adversarial prompts and a redaction fallback: if model returns likely PHI we pipe results through the redaction service. Will add monitoring rules to detect SSN-like patterns or unexpected policy numbers.

jess_cs: Sample path shared and access granted. Created Jira CS-7901 and added to renewal watchlist. Marta + Rui looped. Can we do the workshop Thurs 11AM PT?

Nora_enable: Thurs 11AM PT works — sending invite now and prep materials.

deploy-bot: Jira CS-7901 created: "Sable Insurance claims NER onboarding — PHI controls" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-7901

Li_sre: Tentatively holding Dedicated slot the week of the workshop. If they commit we'll finalize sizing and billing.

Tom_eng: I'll kick off AB runs once sample is visible. Expect results in 48 hours.

jess_cs: Thanks all — next steps in CS-7901: ENG run AB evals, SAFETY set pass/fail and adversarial tests, SRE confirm capacity, ENABLE run workshop. Marking high priority for renewal. :lock:
